issue_request: FHIR-45094 asked to add an Evidence.relatedArtifact comment explaining derived-from source attribution and quotation classifier text, and to add an extracted Evidence example showing the source quotation pattern.
initial_application: Commit 5482fd364f504c27b57eaebfee0a9ae43af04f9f, merged via PR #3077, added the requested relatedArtifact comment, quoted-source Evidence example, and example list entry.
additional_context: FHIR-49758 later removed Evidence.relatedArtifact and introduced Evidence.relatesTo/citeAs in the active R6 model; FHIR-53002 later changed relatesTo.type to CodeableConcept/extensible; FHIR-51513 created an Extension Pack relatesto-classifier extension as a possible classifier replacement outside this core checkout.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Reintroducing relatedArtifact guidance would be wrong, and updating the example to a current relatesTo-plus-extension pattern needs CDS/EBM work-group confirmation because the likely classifier mechanism is external to core.
